title: A theory of ROC analysis of rule-out and rule-in diagnostics with applications to mammography data
summary: Multiple diagnostic tests are frequently used to determine the presence of a disease condition in patients. In this paper, we use bivariate copulas to examine the properties of receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves formed when two correlated diagnostic tests are used together to rule-out ("believe the negative") and rule-in ("believe the positive") patients for disease. We use this theory to analyze three mammography data sets where AI devices are applied to reduce radiologists' workload or improve diagnostic performance.
